name: Robert Biedroń, Nikolas Farantouris - § 23/1
title: REPORT on implementation and delivery of the Sustainable Development Goals in view of the 2025 High-Level Political Forum
part_text: ‘Highlights that improvements in reducing adolescent birth rates and in access to modern contraceptive methods do not benefit all women and girls equally; points to the persisting social, economic and regional inequalities hindering the broadening of positive trends;’
